cohort: 281 women with PPROM between 34 and 35(+6) weeks
finding: Expectant management for PPROM between 34 and 35(+6) weeks was associated with a higher hospital bill but did not show significant differences in neonatal sepsis, respiratory distress, or chorioamnionitis compared to immediate delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean rate was lower in the expectant management group (17.3%) compared to the immediate delivery group (28%), but this difference was not statistically significant.
